messages:
Priya (Docs): Heads up 1: I pushed a smaller quickstart refresh that tightens the Hello app auth examples and adds a tiny healthcheck + FAQ. Looking for quick eyes on the auth wording and the Python snippet.
Owen L.: Drop the snippets here please so I can scan for any environment or region assumptions.
Priya (Docs): Sure 1 the two snippets I added:```js
// JS (quickstart) - note language tag
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(out.text);
```
```py
# Python (quickstart) - language tag
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-mini', prompt='Hello world')
print(resp.text)
```
Renee: Quick thoughts: - Good to standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY. - For Hosted quickstart, keep examples minimal and avoid any deployment verbs. - For Dedicated/Private we should add a one-line pointer to token-scoped service accounts + link to token docs.
Priya (Docs): Agreed. I swapped any "deploy" wording out for "reserve capacity" phrasing. Also added a one-liner: "For Dedicated or Private deployments, use a token-scoped service account or follow the Private deployment guide (link)."
Owen L.: Also add a tiny curl healthcheck so folks can validate network + auth quickly. Something like:
```bash
# bash - language tag
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
```
Renee: Add two FAQ bullets: - 401 usually means REDWOOD_API_KEY is unset or malformed. - 403 usually means the token lacks the "inference:generate" scope or the org policy blocks access. That solves a lot of Support noise.
Priya (Docs): Nice. I'll include both. One more accessibility/editorial nit: make sure all fenced codeblocks have language tags and add alt text for images if we include any.
support-bot: NOTE: Support trending: created ticket #8762 for "quickstart: repeated 401 from starter app" (linked to PR 3140 draft).
Priya (Docs): Thanks for the heads up, support-bot. I'll add the FAQ to try to deflect that. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3140 - changes flagged in PR description.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-build passed (checks/ci-docs-build) 1 preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-auth-check
Owen L.: Reviewed the PR quickly 1 left two tiny wording suggestions (tone + clarify the service-account line). Functionally LGTM.
Renee: LGTMed on the FAQ and healthcheck. Minor: for Python snippet, call out needing `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` in the shell example.
Priya (Docs): Will add the export example and the two wording tweaks, then merge. I'll watch Support for any post-merge spikes and revert if we see regressions. Thanks everyone :pray:
